items.note: SP FTS CharpyCool datasheet (snapshot 28f76bcfe70e3e35) and LabWrench page (74cb41d0452e047f) give range -80 to 30 C, stability and heat-removal curve, but no pull-down time to -80 C; web search (distributor pages, LabManager/SelectScience articles) found no stated time. Computing one from heat removal would be an estimate.

Manual-fill 6875 Freezer/Mill: the user fills the LN2 reservoir and the vial is immersed in LN2; the machine has no refrigeration cooldown. The SPEX handbook (50a0dc0b5988de21) gives sample pre-cool times (e.g. 10-15 min) per method, which belong to the experiment run, not to machine cooldown.

SPC-1 datasheet (6d69d588ab57bc7d), HTS leaflet (c800e29cf4e0b6ef) and cryogenerators page (0e75173522936e3e) state no cool-down time. Stirling's generic 2-stage cycle note (4fa1630676b6ea68) says a warm cryogenerator's own cool-down 'requires about 10 minutes only', but it describes 2-stage machines generically, not the single-stage SPC-1 or the liquefier configuration, so not used.

SPC-1T datasheet (bbd871ad35143ec0) and HTS leaflet state no cool-down time. Stirling's generic 2-stage cycle note (4fa1630676b6ea68, https://stirlingcryogenics.com/markets/Stirling-Cycle-2-stage-2023) says the warm cryogenerator first cools itself in 'about 10 minutes only', but it does not name the SPC-1T and covers only the cryogenerator's own cold buffer, not the He circulation loop/remote application reaching 20 K, so it was not taken as this configuration's cooldown. A reviewer may choose to accept it as a family figure.

CT datasheet (d041cbe2ab9e0c1f) has no cooldown figure; the CT Operator Manual (d24c2809cad3b9f8) has 'Figure 2-5. CryoTel CT Cooldown Time' but only as a graph with no extractable number in text. Reading a value off the plot would be an estimate. Web search found no stated time.

GT datasheet (82018cad1a8fba80) has no cooldown figure; the GT Operator Manual (8f7771ba9c1e9309) has 'Figure 2-5. CryoTel GT Cooldown Time' but only as a graph with no number in text. Web search found no stated time for the GT.

items.quote: To reach -100oC with microreactors the average time is 75mins.
items.document_title: Asia Tech Sup Note - Cooling Rates for Asia Cryo Controller (Syrris, v1.0, 25/05/2016)
items.note: Syrris technical note: average time for the Asia Cryo Controller to bring a glass microreactor to -100 C. It is an average, and the note says rates depend on reactor size, flow rate, solvent heat capacity and ambient temperature (above 20 C ambient -100 C may not be reached).

Tenney thermal shock brochure (2c63144eaa3fe222) says only that temperature recovery should be reviewed by the factory; the spec-table PDF has no extractable text (32f8b3182c6b361d, 15 chars); product page (b8c0469d8a6a3b36) and TPS sales sheet (a624d3dfda31a80e) give no pull-down time. Web search found none.
Same sources as TS2 size 2: no cold-chamber pull-down time is stated for the TS2 size 8; the spec-table PDF is image-only and the brochure defers recovery to the factory.
